intro.title: Request & Response
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Express server that handles incoming HTTP requests and sends back custom responses. You will learn the core concepts of the request and response objects, which are fundamental to web development. The main technologies involved are the Express framework and JavaScript, using methods like `req.params` to access URL data and `res.send()` to return content. By the end, you'll understand how to read client input and dynamically generate server replies.
intro.usecase: Every time you submit a form, click a button, or navigate between pages in a web application, you're triggering requests and responses. In Express, this pattern powers user interactions like submitting contact forms, adding items to shopping carts, or filtering search results on e-commerce sites. As a developer, you'll use request objects to access user input (like form data or URL parameters) and response objects to send back appropriate content—whether it's rendering a dashboard with updated analytics or returning JSON data for a mobile app. Understanding this request-response cycle is fundamental to building any interactive web feature that processes user actions and provides dynamic feedback.
